ucs.comments: Prefrontal context input to the striatum
Dopamine neurons signalling reward prediction error
ucs.requirement: Compute the reward prediction error. input: [U.NAC] (expected value); output: [U.NAC] (prediction error).
ucs.requirementRealization: The single input [U.NAC] supplies the expected value that is subtracted from the received reward; the output returns the error to [U.NAC].
ucs.mechanism: Phasic firing rises above baseline for unexpected reward and dips below baseline when an expected reward is omitted.

ucs.requirement: Learn state values. input: [U.A9/46d@L] (task context), [U.VTA] (prediction error); output: [U.VTA] (expected value), [U.Arc] (value-based drive).
ucs.requirementRealization: Context from [U.A9/46d@L] selects the state, the error from [U.VTA] updates its value, and the value is sent to [U.VTA] and [U.Arc].
ucs.capability: Value learning by a three-factor plasticity rule [Haber, 2010].
ucs.mechanism: Dopamine-gated plasticity of cortico-striatal synapses stores the value of each context.

collections.comments: Dopaminergic midbrain-striatal loop, grouped for reading the HCD
